title: Time Connectors in a Story
goal: Control the speed of a story in the past with apenas, en cuanto, al cabo de, a medida que and conforme.

items: I can make one event follow another at once with apenas and en cuanto.
I can skip a stretch of time with al cabo de and show gradual change with a medida que and conforme.
I can use the new words for timing in a story.
